description: Java class implementing a CoAP observe client without security, using Eclipse Californium library, for observing resource updates from a server.

classes.name: NoSecObserveClient
classes.description: A client for observing CoAP resources without security, managing observation lifecycle and handling responses.

methods.name: NoSecObserveClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CoAP client with server URI and setting up the latch.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the observation process, handles incoming responses, and cancels observation after receiving specified responses.

methods.name: getFutureUrl
methods.description: Constructs the CoAP URL for the resource to observe based on host, port, and access token.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for running the client from command line, parsing arguments, and initiating observation.
